title: ImportWizard
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column holding MonarchStepper, MonarchFileUpload (androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument underneath), MonarchColumnMapping, MonarchPreviewRows, MonarchProgress and MonarchBanner; android.content.ContentResolver.openInputStream to read the file
summary: A recipe, not a component: import records from a CSV file in four steps (upload, map columns to fields, preview every row with its problems, import and report) composed from MonarchStepper, MonarchFileUpload, MonarchColumnMapping, MonarchPreviewRows, MonarchProgress and MonarchBanner.
whenToUse: When people bring their own records from a spreadsheet or another product: contacts, products, leads, transactions.
whenNotToUse: For adding one record, use a form. For files that are kept as attachments rather than read, use MonarchFileUpload alone.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStepper(steps: List<MonarchStepperStep>, current: Int, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, …)

@Composable fun MonarchFileUpload(onFiles: (accepted: List<MonarchPickedFile>, rejected: List<MonarchFileRejection>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, …, accept: List<String> = emptyList(), maxSize: Long? = null, maxFiles: Int? = null, …, hint: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, …)

@Composable public fun MonarchColumnMapping(sources: List<MonarchColumnMappingSource>, mapping: Map<String, String>, fields: List<MonarchColumnMappingField>, onMappingChange: (Map<String, String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, …, showIssues: Boolean = true, …)

fun MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.suggest(sources: List<MonarchColumnMappingSource>, fields: List<MonarchColumnMappingField>, threshold: Double = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD): Map<String, MonarchColumnMappingSuggestion>
fun MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.issues(mapping: Map<String, String>, fields: List<MonarchColumnMappingField>): MonarchColumnMappingIssues

@Composable fun MonarchPreviewRows(rows: List<MonarchPreviewRow>, columns: List<MonarchPreviewRowsColumn>, label: String, filter: MonarchPreviewRowStatus?, onFilterChange: (MonarchPreviewRowStatus?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, …)
@Composable fun MonarchProgress(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, progress: Float? = null, variant: MonarchProgressVariant = MonarchProgressVariant.Linear, label: String? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchBanner(message: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Info, title: String? = null, …, announcement: MonarchBannerAnnouncement = MonarchBannerAnnouncement.None)

states.name: upload
states.description: The stepper on Upload and MonarchFileUpload for one CSV file; a file without data rows shows the error on the Browse files button.

states.name: map
states.description: MonarchColumnMapping with the suggested mapping; Check rows shows the missing required fields and duplicates, and moves on only when there are none.

states.name: preview
states.description: MonarchPreviewRows with every row's status and problems, filterable by status; the import button names how many rows will be imported and is disabled when none can be.

states.name: importing
states.description: An indeterminate MonarchProgress with "Importing 12 rows"; Back and Import are disabled.

states.name: results
states.description: A success MonarchBanner with the counts, announced politely, and Import another file.

appearance: Monarch parts on the screen's surface: the stepper with the current step in the accent, the dashed upload zone, the mapping list, the preview list with status badges in their tones, a linear progress bar and a success banner. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ImportWizard is one component with built-in CSV parsing, a duplicate-rule choice, a template download, paging in the preview, a downloadable problems CSV and a report of created, updated, skipped and failed rows. On Android it is a recipe the app owns: MonarchFileUpload opens the system document picker, the app reads the file through the ContentResolver off the main thread with its own CSV or spreadsheet reader, runs its own validation and import, and writes counts with plurals resources. A duplicate rule, when needed, is a radio group or segmented buttons on the preview step; the problems file is written with ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument. The web's mapping is field to column; MonarchColumnMapping keeps column to field. Steps that hold MonarchColumnMapping and MonarchPreviewRows give them the remaining height, because both are lazy lists. There is no iOS entry yet.
accessibility: Each MonarchStepper step is one element read with its position, such as "Step 2 of 4, Map columns", and its state.
MonarchFileUpload's Browse files button opens the system picker; errorText is the button's error and is shown under the zone.
MonarchColumnMapping labels each picker "Field for <column>"; the missing-fields message is an error and a polite live region.
MonarchPreviewRows reads each row with its outcome, values and problems; the filter tabs read their name with the count.
MonarchProgress is named "Importing 12 rows"; the result banner is a polite live region, so the result is announced without moving focus.
edgeCases: Read the file on Dispatchers.IO; a large file read on the main thread freezes the screen.
A file with only a header row is refused on the upload step with a message, not on the preview step.
Splitting lines on commas breaks quoted fields that contain commas; a real import uses a CSV reader.
Rows with errors are skipped and counted, so the import button names only the rows that will be saved.
Going back from the preview keeps the mapping, so a fix to one column does not lose the others.
